meta.name: affiliate-blog-builder
meta.description: Write SEO-optimized affiliate blog articles, product reviews, comparison posts, listicles, and how-to guides. Triggers on: "write a blog post about", "review of [product]", "best [category] article", "comparison blog", "affiliate blog", "SEO article", "write a review", "product roundup", "blog content for affiliate", "how to use [product] blog post", "listicle about [category]", "[product] vs [product] blog", "content for my affiliate site".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动撰写SEO优化的联盟营销博客文章
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果运营联盟营销网站，需要大量SEO优化的产品文章。
copy.tagline_en: Write SEO-optimized affiliate blog articles automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run an affiliate site and need SEO-optimized product articles at scale.

howto.what: Claude 会根据你的要求，生成一篇完整的、针对搜索引擎优化的联盟营销博客文章。它支持产品评论、两款产品对比、最佳产品列表和教程指南四种格式。文章会包含元数据、FAQ 结构、行动号召按钮和联盟链接，可以直接复制到你的博客平台发布。
howto.when: 当你说出“写一篇关于...的博客”、“评论[产品]”、“最佳[类别]文章”、“对比博客”等关键词，或者明确要求写一篇联盟博客时触发。

say.text: 写一篇关于 HeyGen 的产品评论。
say.note: Claude 会生成一篇完整的评论文章。

say.text: 比较 Synthesia 和 HeyGen 的博客。
say.note: 生成一篇两产品对比文章。

say.text: 写一份最佳 AI 视频工具列表。
say.note: 生成列表文章，自动搜索产品。

howto.what_en: Claude generates a complete, SEO-optimized affiliate blog article. It supports four formats: product review, comparison, best-of listicle, and how-to guide. The output includes metadata, FAQ schema, CTAs, and affiliate links, ready to paste into a blog platform.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say phrases like "write a blog post about", "review of [product]", "best [category] article", "comparison blog", or any similar request for an affiliate blog.

say_en.text: Write a detailed review of HeyGen for my blog.
Write a comparison blog: Synthesia vs HeyGen.
Write a listicle on best AI video tools.
say_en.note: Searches for products and writes a roundup.
